definitions.explanation: The natural process of getting older over time. Used especially in medical, health, and scientific contexts to describe age-related changes, as opposed to {老化|ろうか} which emphasizes deterioration.

examples.japanese: {加齢|かれい}とともに{体力|たいりょく}が{落|お}ちる。
{加齢|かれい}による{肌|はだ}の{変化|へんか}が{気|き}になる。
examples.english: I'm concerned about age-related changes in my skin.

examples.japanese: {加齢|かれい}{臭|しゅう}を{防|ふせ}ぐための{対策|たいさく}が{人気|にんき}を{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: Measures to prevent body odor from aging are gaining popularity.

notes:
A neutral, somewhat clinical term for aging. Compared to {老化|ろうか} (deterioration due to aging), {加齢|かれい} simply describes the passage of years without the negative connotation of decline. Frequently used in health and beauty product marketing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{加齢|かれい}とともに — with aging, as one gets older
・{加齢|かれい}による — caused by aging, age-related
・{加齢|かれい}{臭|しゅう} — body odor associated with aging
・{加齢|かれい}{現象|げんしょう} — age-related phenomenon
・{加齢|かれい}{対策|たいさく} — anti-aging measures
